scope: Six opaque partial records; original inventories, exact quoted bytes, source identities, actor applicability, dated formal events and adequacy of disclosed legal uncertainty. No complete lifecycle or status adoption.

d6.method: Case-insensitive rg over the existing held official-original text directory, then complete-source EO12106 page verification and narrow cited-statute text/page review.
d6.query: 11022|11256|11376|11782|11829|11853|Council on Aging|Food and Fiber|Financing Bank Advisory|Hopi.Navajo Land Settlement
d6.limits: Only 20 held extracted-text files; OCR and multiline/title gaps, unheld statutes, reports, court records, subsequent instruments and cutoff-wide completeness remain open. No absence finding from non-hits.

global_limits: Partial accept means only the enumerated components are upheld. It is not acceptance for whole-lifecycle publication or readiness.
No verdict independently upholds the inherited whole_order_status or every clause state_at_cutoff; first_end, whole_order_end and savings/residual conclusions remain unapproved.
No acquisition-wrapper audit is attested: the packet narrative about three wrappers is outside this source-only component review.
No human certification, cross-family review, codebook change or automatic count/status promotion.
A revealed material missed control must stop expansion; these frozen verdicts must not be rewritten after reveal.

verdicts.original_inventory: All seven original sections and their exact quoted spans are present. The legal characterization of section 6 is materially false.
verdicts.source_identity: EO11256 is confirmed on 30 FR 14137-14138; signed 1965-11-04, published 1965-11-10.
verdicts.actor_applicability: EO12379 section 18 directly names EO11256 and both bodies; formal revocation on the dated 1982-08-17 instrument is supported, not a first-cessation finding.

errors.finding: Section 6 says the Committee and Commission shall terminate ninety days after submission of the Commission final report. This is an express conditional termination, distinct from the section 4(c) eighteen-month reporting deadline. The record instead denies any legal effect of actual submission and claims first cessation in 1982. Its null first_end and partial disclaimer do not cure those affirmative assertions.
The emergency-board/board-of-inquiry ruling on a mere reporting deadline does not erase this separately expressed termination condition in a Food and Fiber order.

accepted_components: Original identity and seven-section quotation inventory
Section 7 separately revokes EO10472 and EO10937; no revival established by later cleanup
EO12379 direct naming and dated formal event
open_gaps: Actual final-report submission, and the resulting ninety-day calculation, must be investigated; do not substitute a deadline or publication date for the event.
Compensation, assistance, administrative services, report transmission, executed revocations and residual effects need separate treatment.
Amendments, factual events and counterevidence through the cutoff remain open.
verdicts.d6_finding: The original itself supplies material earlier-ending counterevidence. The limited local text search does not establish whether or when the final report was actually submitted.

verdicts.original_inventory: Incomplete: the record supplies sections 1 and 2 and asserts that there are only TWO sections. The complete official page has three.
verdicts.source_identity: EO11782, 39 FR 15991, signed 1974-05-06 and published 1974-05-07, is confirmed.
verdicts.actor_applicability: EO12379 section 15 directly revokes the Advisory Council order. It does not purport to dissolve the statutory Federal Financing Bank.

errors.finding: Treasury must, to the extent permitted by law, provide administrative support for the Council. This independent addressee and administrative duty is missing from the claimed complete inventory and its two inventory overrides. Open savings and search gaps do not disclose or excuse this omission.

Eight listed officers; section 2 advice/assistance and coordinating-forum functions
Direct formal revocation and statutory Bank/Council distinction

open_gaps: P.L.96-88 section 509 application, section 505 savings and section 601 implementation/effective date remain unresolved; no membership event date approved.

verdicts.original_inventory: All four operative sections are present, including invited temporary members, annual reporting, support and cooperation duties, and section 4 abolition/supersession.
verdicts.source_identity: EO11022, 27 FR 4659, signed 1962-05-14 and published 1962-05-17, is confirmed. The later-actor identity correction proposed in the rationale is wrong.
verdicts.actor_applicability: EO11376 directly substitutes section 1(b); EO12379 section 12 directly revokes EO11022 as amended. EO12106 section 1-103 is an additional actual membership replacement, effective 1979-01-01 under section 1-106.

errors.kind: wrong-actor exclusion and omitted material amendment
errors.finding: The complete official pages are headed EO12106, December 28, 1978. Section 1-103 expressly replaces EO11022 section 1(b); section 1-106 expressly provides January 1, 1979 effectiveness. Calling this a mislabeled source requiring correction to actual EO12107 rejects a correctly identified material event. The adjacent EO12107 starts on page 321/44 FR 1055. The event must be recorded with before-and-after membership; it need not change the final revocation date to be material.

EO11376 proved amendment relationship
EO12379 section 12 dated formal revocation
No asserted revival of the prior 1959 Council
open_gaps: Correct the EO12106 exclusion, record its real event and before/after clause text, and consider other redesignation or transferred-function events.
Analyze executed section 4 action and residual effects separately from continuing Council functions.
Earlier endings, savings and full counterevidence coverage remain open.
verdicts.d6_finding: Bounded held-source search found EO12106; the official complete actor pages establish the omitted/rejected membership event. This contradicts an affirmative packet premise, not merely an unfinished search.

verdicts.original_inventory: The complete instrument, including its enabling preamble and replacement text, is supplied. Its operative action is only the replacement of EO11829 section 2(a).
verdicts.source_identity: EO11853, 40 FR 17537, signed 1975-04-17 and published 1975-04-21, is confirmed.

The replacement connects information work expressly to the expeditious and orderly development of factual information for negotiations. EO12379 section 11 names EO11829 as amended; it does not directly name EO11853 or independently date first cessation.
accepted_components: Complete original inventory, exact spans and identity
Proved specific parent section 2(a) amendment and before/after content
No separate independent command in EO11853 outside the substitution

verdicts.original_inventory: The complete one-amendment instrument is included. The official page resolves OCR T1376 to EO11376, with no independent command outside the section 1(b) substitution.
verdicts.source_identity: EO11376, 32 FR 14545, signed 1967-10-17 and published 1967-10-19, is confirmed. Later amendment identity is misstated in the rationale and gap instruction.
verdicts.actor_applicability: The proved dependent relationship is to EO11022 section 1(b). EO12379 section 12 names the parent as amended, not EO11376 directly. This supports parent-clause reach only and supplies no independently established first-end date for the amending instrument.

errors.kind: wrong-actor exclusion and omitted material amendment
errors.finding: The instruction not to cite the supposedly mislabeled EO12106 is false. Its official pages expressly replace the same parent membership clause effective January 1, 1979. EO12107 is a separate neighboring instrument. The strike-and-insert ruling preserves the continuing amended clause but requires the actual material amendment as a later event with before-and-after text; it does not make omission immaterial.

Seven-member Committee; information/liaison functions and Interior support
Actual EO11853 before/after section 2(a) relationship

verdicts.d6_finding: The original, amendment and P.L.93-531 sections 1, 3 and 4 support the disclosed earlier conditional-ending issue. The limited local search supplies no actual completion/notice/transfer date; no negative-search clearance is granted.
